notes.title: Summary of the Update for 11/26
notes.content:
[b]New Online Battle Mode "Megarobo Batroseum" added![/b]

In this mode, you can enjoy a Battle Royale or Team Battles with up to 6 players. Since you choose from pre-customized machines, you can start playing immediately without having to enhance or collect parts. Plus, a new feature, the "Sengi System," is introduced. Join the action in this easy-to-participate online mode and enjoy more intense robot battles than ever before!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/9546c5d90b7cec1bd14d3cfb4029ecb52cb698bf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/6990e3dd3b7041902c45d555d4dac7b437fcd7b7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/1d6120d03047d8f2af7a6ffc2a8e07b5913d89ce.jpg[/img]


[b]New Feature Exclusive to Megarobo Batroseum: The "Sengi System"」[/b]
Each Rogue has a unique power called "Sengi" based on its type. Fill up its gauge through actions like attacking, and activate it to use special techniques. For example, the Melee Type can send flying slashes with close-range attacks, while the Ranged Type can create a barrier that nullifies incoming ranged attacks.
These Sengi can greatly change the course of battle, so utilize them at the right time to claim victory!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/6cf7adc0bfe819d772c4eaddf1a496a71c105577.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/15d6b80f1be8d427061640caae0374fa279533f8.jpg[/img]

Check out the latest PV to see how the Sengi System works!
[previewyoutube=jJLfSDOIjC0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Legendary Pilots Join the Fight![/b]
Legendary pilots will be available for play in each mission, online play, as well as in Megarobo Batroseum.
These 5 pilots will join the fray: Koji Kabuto from "Mazinger Z," Ryoma Nagare from "Getter Robot," Duke Fleed from "Grendizer," Hyoma Aoi from "Combattler V" and Kenichi Go from "Voltes V."
You can also fight with the iconic robots from each of these titles, so we hope you have fun mixing and matching your favorite pilots and robots!

notes.title: [Megaton Info].
notes.content:
[h3][b][Megaton Info].[/b][/h3]
[h2]Here are some useful tips on how to complete the Dreadnaught Class Missions![/h2]

If you just got started with Musashi and are struggling with the Dreadnaught Class Mission, this guide is for you!

Since the Dark Hunter G in "Tyrannical Beast" attacks with its powerful fangs or body press that has a large area of effect, avoid attacking it up front!

It is best to deal with all the smaller enemies that appear during the battle by grouping them together using Knights of the Gaia or Colosseum Rush!

You can obtain powerful parts & weapons a a reward, such as Iconic Legendary  Musashi R, Musashi-O, Kamui or Fuga, which will prove especially useful to players who have just started the Dreadnaught Class Missions, so be sure to give it a try!

notes.title: Must-see for Beginners! Quick Tips and Tricks
notes.content:
We share tips and tricks that will help pilots who want to further enhance their Rogues and complete missions more efficiently!
Please make use of it in your gameplay!

------------------------
[h2]When you're unsure of how to strengthen your Rogue...[/h2]
[h3][b]Rec. Enhancement[/b][/h3]
------------------------

This feature recommends enhancement options when you're unsure of how to strengthen your Rogues!

You can enhance your Rogue by simply selecting items with the thumbs up icon! Be sure to take advantage of it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/041dbcac109aa2cce879727575a51d8e0357c95e.png[/img]

------------------------
[h2]Earning EXP efficiently[/h2]
[h3][b]EXP Cartridges/Rec. Mission[/b][/h3]
------------------------

EXP Cartridges give you 1.5 times more EXP!
Use them on the "Hands-On Training" Treasure Mission, which already gives you a large amount of EXP, to increase your yield even further.

Side Missions from XM-17 onwards, especially WM-01, WM-02, and WM-03 on Megaton difficulty are also recommended!
Efficiently raise your Player Rank by using EXP Cartridges!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/b5a32015a4240371518963c716b2af4b3350c051.png[/img]

------------------------
[h2]Missions with bonuses offer great value[/h2]
[h3][b]Mission Bonus[/b][/h3]
------------------------

When choosing which mission to go on, we recommend those that come with a "Mission Bonus!"

Not only will they give you more items than usual, you will also get random bonuses such as EXP, credits, and pilot points!

It seems that there are also paint colors for Rogue parts that can only be obtained from missions with a bonus.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/b7ddda13441fb87be90a7abd6129448f8a55ca8c.jpg[/img]

------------------------
[h2]Quickly dismantling unnecessary items[/h2]
[h3][b]Auto-Dismantle[/b][/h3]
------------------------

At the end of a mission, parts, weapons, and other items you have obtained can be automatically dismantled.

Once your Rogue is strong enough, you might no longer need Common or Uncommon items.
Using the Auto-Dismantle function eliminates the need to manually dismantle them!

Use the button at the bottom of the mission list screen to select which items to automatically disassemble.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/be0243fd846b1413b8f515ec371889efd5f1f6dd.jpg[/img]

If you would like to know more tips, please check out the website below!
[h3][b]https://www.megaton-musashi.jp/wired/en/beginner/[/b][/h3]

notes.content:
[h3][b]"UFO Robot Grendizer" Collaboration Event Announced![/b][/h3]

The first major free update (ver. 3.1.0) for MEGATON MUSASHI W: WIRED is scheduled to be released soon. In ver. 3.1.0, "UFO Robot Grendizer" will finally enter the fray! 

Not only can you control it as a Rogue itself, but you can also combine with Spazer and fight in UFO form. In addition to special moves such as "Space Thunder" and "Screw Crusher Punch," you can also experience action-packed specials unique to Musashi.

You can obtain the collaboration Rogue by simply updating the game. Don't miss the chance to pilot this legendary mech yourself!
A trailer to commemorate the collaboration is out now.

notes.title: Sneak Peek of the Next Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is the "Megaton Musashi" team.
We are excited to give our players an early look at the upcoming update.

[h3][b]New Update Features[/b][/h3]

[u][b]■Introducing New Rogues[/b][/u]
Dragoknight (Iconic Legendary, Iconic Legendary II)
Rogue Ability: A skill that can utilize the Lance's Aura state.

Amabushi (Relic Legendary)
Rogue Ability: A skill that can make use of your Rogue's broken down parts.

More new Rogues planned!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/3e5311430cf00b44e9dd5fd40426a7f6bd535b72.jpg[/img]

[u][b]■New Rogues Added to Iconic II![/b][/u]
Armored Gaudia & Sparkman Wave
Additional new Rogues planned for Iconic II!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/7418ff4fee8c80ea7895aac5efc83724c01a92d6.jpg[/img]

[u][b]■Introducing New Weapons[/b][/u]
Many new weapons will be added, including Relic Legendary and Iconic Legendary II!

[u][b]■New Super Dreadnought Class Missions Added[/b][/u]
Winged Animus,Musashi Wired and more
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/5a70828fa392b96ca7489100cc05340eae14600c.jpg[/img]

[u][b]■New Missions Added to Megaton II[/b][/u]
Yoshitsune Dragoon Exhaust, Diablos, and more
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/535c100bb83accc1e59ebe995cd911a2e3ae334a.jpg[/img]

[u][b]■Easier to Attempt Missions Added to Megaton II![/b][/u]
Added multiple new Side Missions, Challenge Missions, and more
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/e66cbc0badc57e25dc6106ae36cd3662296f3511.jpg[/img]

[u][b]■New Rogues for Colosseum Battles[/b][/u]
Mazinger Z, Getter Robot
Colosseum battle parts for collaboration rogues will be distributed with the update!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951635/c0bc29929703219ed31b7f18d322c8df98e7ab16.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Feature Improvements[/b][/h3]

[u][b]■Laboratory Functionality Improved[/b][/u]
Recycling:
Batch execution now possible, reducing effort!

Adapter Enhancement:
Basic skills can also be enhanced in batches!

[u][b]■Other changes[/b][/u]
・ Diagonal movement added when locking on
・ Changed time limit for Megaton II from 10 to 12 minutes
・ Timing for Kakugo System buttons adjusted for easier activation
・ Size and transparency of attack effects adjusted for better visibility
・ Added a new Motherboard Circuit
　(A Cell that gives you Super Armor when dashing)
・ Added α version of special skills to Motherboard Circuit Development
・ Added skills that can be set in Neural Board slots IV and V
・ Ace Pilot Coins revised
・ Changed the maximum number of items that can be held to 9999

Click here for details:
https://www.megaton-musashi.jp/wired/en/patchnote/ver_3_1_0/
